features.name: A streaming answer
features.what: While the agent answers, the text grows in place and the composer shows Stop. A reply taller than the screen stops the follow at its start and offers Scroll to bottom. While the view follows it, the transcript fades out above the composer.

features.proof: Stop shows during the stream; after it the reply's start is on screen, Scroll to bottom is offered and brings the reply's last sentence into view. The fade is on while the reply streams and the view follows, off as soon as the reader scrolls away, and off once the reply ends.
